units.title: mit2_008_s25_hw1_pdf
examples: features showing a lid was thermoformed, and its cycle
injection moulding a toy part: fill pressure, clamping force and cooling time
thermoplastic or thermoset, and which suits injection moulding

units.title: mit2_008_s25_hw2_pdf
examples: Merchant's circle: name the cutting forces and find the shear angle
milling time and process plan for a phone housing
turning a shaft from 25 to 20 mm: speed, removal rate and time

units.title: mit2_008_s25_hw3_pdf
examples: brazing against soldering and choosing a joining method
design-for-assembly review of a motor drive
temperature to shrink-fit a ring onto a shaft

units.title: mit2_008_s25_hw4_pdf
examples: Cp, Cpk and the fraction out of spec of a pocket diameter
bearing press fit: interference limits from tolerances
will rings fit bodies: worst-case and statistical stack

units.title: mit2_008_s25_hw7_pdf
examples: how a brass valve body was cast (parting line, cores)
pour velocity and fill time of a sand mould; solidification time
stamping against additive manufacture for a car panel

units.title: mit2_008_s25_quiz1_pdf
examples: injection moulding a toy brick: flow-path ratio, clamping force and cavities
limits, Cp = Cpk and the process mean and σ of a stud diameter
peak cutting power and force when grooving aluminium

units.title: mit2_008_s25_quiz2_part_a_pdf
examples: springback rises or falls with thickness, yield and modulus
